runs: run1: clientInfo.name=aang_desktop_emu, env CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE=Codex, hooks untrusted -> no hooks fired
run2: clientInfo.name=codex_desktop, title='Codex Desktop', override=Codex, hooks trusted -> 6 hooks fired
conclusion: session_meta.originator = env CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE if set, else clientInfo.name (process-wide, fixed by first initialize); source='vscode' for any app-server client. Live Desktop sets CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE='Codex Desktop' (value with a space; confirmed by codex-appserver researcher), which explains originator 'Codex Desktop' in real rollouts
